s: Hessian (native or inhabitant of the state of Hesse, Germany) (usually male)
Hesse.et: From Middle High German Hesse, from Old High German Hesso, possibly ultimately derived from Proto-Germanic *hatjaną (“to persecute; hate”). Compare Chatti, Chasuarii, Chattuarii.

s: a habitational surname for an inhabitant of Hesse
hessian, burlap (a strong, coarse fabric made from hemp or jute)

Hessen.et: Originally the dative plural of Hesse m (“Hessian”), meaning "(the land) by the Hessians".
